# 🚀 Welcome to the LewdZone Launcher Community!

We are thrilled to officially announce **LewdZone Launcher** — a high-performance, cross-platform desktop game launcher and native CLI client designed specifically for [lewdzone.com](https://lewdzone.com). The latest release is **v0.4.1**.

## 🌟 What is LewdZone Launcher?

LewdZone Launcher unifies catalog browsing, token resolution, direct file streaming, high-speed 7-Zip CLI extraction, and rich game library organization into a single lightweight desktop app and native CLI:

- **Desktop GUI + Native CLI**: Unified Tauri 2 + Rust core with 100% GUI/CLI feature parity (`lewdzone <cmd> --json`).
- **Smart Download Routing**: In-app streaming for direct file hosts (`fileknot`, `pixeldrain`, `mediafire`, `workupload`) and native OS default handler handoff for cloud mirrors (`mega`, `google`, `dropbox`, etc.).
- **7-Zip CLI Integration**: High-speed archive extraction (`.zip`, `.7z`, `.rar`, `.tar.gz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, SFX `.exe`) powered by standalone 7-Zip console binaries with real-time percentage progress.
- **Malicious Host Shielding**: Blacklist protection rejecting defunct or malicious file hosts (`gofile`, `zippyshare`, `cdnclick`, `anonfiles`, `uptobox`, `yourfilestore`, `qiwi`, `transfersh`).
- **Flat Library Layout**: Clean `<download-dir>/<archive>` downloads and `<library-root>/installed/<slug>/` installs with automatic itch.io-compatible `app.json` manifests.
- **Metadata Enrichment**: Poster and banner art integration via SteamGridDB, VNDB, IGDB, itch.io, Steam, and IndieDB.
- **System Tray & Dynamic Theming**: Minimize to system tray and switch between Nord, Dracula, and Material themes on the fly.
